onboarding.title: rettich
onboarding.lede: Snap the receipt. We'll tell you what needs eating.
onboarding.question: Want to name your fridge?
onboarding.footnote: No email, no password. This browser stays signed in for ten years.

today.empty_body: Next time you shop, point the camera at the receipt.

capture.title: What did you get?
capture.camera_hint: Receipt or the shopping itself — it works out which
capture.voice_hint: For when your hands are full
capture.still_reading: Still reading — long receipts take a little longer.
capture.review_lede: We got these. Remove anything that is not right — nothing to confirm.
capture.hard_to_read: That one was hard to read.
capture.unreadable: That one was hard to read. Want to try again, or just tell us the fresh stuff?
capture.no_camera: We couldn't open the camera. You can type it instead.
capture.no_mic: We couldn't hear anything. You can type it instead.

shutter.searching: Point at the receipt or the shopping
shutter.too_dark: A bit dark — move to the light

capture.mic_blocked: The microphone is blocked for this page. Allow it in your browser's settings, or type it instead.

detect.too_slow: Outlines off — too slow on this phone ({{ms}} ms)

capture.say_again: Sorry, that did not come through. Say it once more, then tap Done.
capture.rec_prompt: Say what you bought, then tap Done.

memo.title: Shopping
memo.dictate: Hold to say an item, tap for a list
memo.shared: One list for this kitchen. Everyone who opened the share link sees the same lines.
memo.hold_hint: Hold to say an item · tap for a list
memo.try_again: Voice works differently here. Press the mic again.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.lede: One meal from what's already in the kitchen. Each one, once a day.
recipes.empty_body: Once there's food in here, pick a meal.
recipes.pick: Pick a meal and we'll suggest something from what's in the kitchen.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.accidental_open: Accidental touch. This is unopened again.
kitchen.remove_not_waste: Added by mistake. It does not count as wasted.
kitchen.swipe_hint: Tip: swipe a card left to delete it

install.title: Add to your home screen
install.pitch: Add rettich to your home screen — it opens straight to the camera.
install.ios_steps: Tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
install.unavailable: Your browser will offer this once you've used the app a couple of times.

settings.title: You
settings.identity_note: Kept in this browser and in a ten-year cookie. Clear both on every phone that has the kitchen and it's gone — one receipt rebuilds it.
settings.your_name_note: Optional. It shows next to what you add, so the others can see it was you. It stays on this phone.
settings.share_note: Open this on another phone. It becomes the same kitchen — the same food and the same shopping list. No account.
settings.share_care: Anyone with this link can open the kitchen.
settings.qr_alt: QR code that opens this kitchen
settings.stub_mode: Sample mode: photos and voice use example answers, so nothing new is billed.
settings.forget_note: Deletes everything we hold for this fridge, on this phone and on every phone that opened it. There is no undo.
settings.failures: {{count}} reads did not go through. You can always type or say what you got.
settings.switch_gone: That kitchen no longer exists — it was forgotten on another phone. You're still in this one.
settings.switch_failed: Couldn't switch kitchens. Check your connection and try again.

join.title: Open this kitchen
join.lede: This phone will use the shared kitchen. Same food, same shopping list.
join.switch: This phone already has a kitchen. Opening this one switches it. The other kitchen stays with anyone who still has its link.
join.invalid: That link doesn't open a kitchen.
join.too_many: That is a lot of tries. Give it an hour.

errors.offline: You're offline. This will keep working when you're back.
errors.too_big: That photo was a bit big. Try again.
errors.server: Our end had a wobble. Try that again?

notify.title: Notifications
notify.ask_title: Want a nudge when food needs using?
notify.ask_body: Around dinner time, at most once a week, and only when something is worth using. Nothing else.
notify.needs_install: On iPhone, add rettich to your Home Screen first (Share, then "Add to Home Screen"). Then turn notifications on under You.
notify.on_note: This phone also gets it on the lock screen.
notify.off_note: Get it on this phone’s lock screen too.
notify.budget: At most, for the whole kitchen:
notify.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. You can allow them again in your browser's site settings.
notify.bell_note: When food is worth using, it shows under the bell around dinner time, on every phone in the kitchen.

bell.title: Notifications
bell.label: Notifications
bell.empty: No reminders yet. When food is worth using, one comes here around dinner time.
bell.push_offer: Get these on your lock screen too.
